import json
im=json.load(open('/tmp/snap.json'))
def field(s,c,o,n):
 x=int(im['banks'][s][c//2],16);b=128 if c&1 else 0;return (x>>(b+o))&((1<<n)-1)
s,c=2,0
print('type',field(s,c,0,3),'bulkmap',hex(field(s,c,63,64)),'base',field(s,c,127,22),'stage',field(s,c,149,4))
for i in range(3):
 raw=field(s,c,153+32*i,32)
 print('direct',i,raw&63,(raw>>6)&15,(raw>>10)&0x3fffff)
print('bitmapid',field(s,c,25,16),'ni',field(s,c,41,22))
# map bulk keys to expected cells
bm=field(s,c,63,64);base=field(s,c,127,22)
for key in range(64):
 if bm>>key&1:
  ord=bin(bm&((1<<key)-1)).count('1')
  print('bulk key',key,'cell',base+2*ord,'type',field(1,base+2*ord,0,3))
